title: Free Music Lesson Software (2026): 4 Options Compared
description: Free music lesson software compared: Trio and Nova Music free plans (10 students), TutorTally (2 students free) and Duet, with published upgrade prices.
h1: Free music lesson software for teachers
body:
Free music lesson software exists, but every free plan we found stops at a small number of students, and most leave out online card payments. We checked each vendor's own pricing page or App Store listing on November 2, 2026 and list only what they publish; anything not published is marked unknown.

{{table:trio,nova-music,tutortally,duet}}

Free plans compared

  • Trio Free: $0, free forever with no card, for up to 10 active students and one team member (the owner). It includes scheduling, invoices, cash and check payments, the parent portal and the Ask Trio assistant. Pro is $5/mo or $50/yr and removes the student limit and adds team members, online payments (card, bank, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Cash App Pay), automatic late fees and calendar sync. Max is $20/mo or $200/yr. Extra seats on Pro and Max are $5/mo or $50/yr each. Trio plans {{aff:trio|Visit Trio}}
  • Nova Music Free: $0 for up to 10 students, with scheduling and calendar, basic attendance, direct messaging, a student portal with gamification, lesson notes and assignments, practice logging, CSV export and 100 MB of file storage. Pro is $10/mo or $100/yr and adds unlimited students, advanced billing and iCal/Google calendar sync. Nova Music pricing {{aff:novamusic|Visit Nova Music}}
  • TutorTally Free: $0 for your first 2 students with every feature included (invoices, reminders, groups and reports) and no time limit. For more students it's $9.99/mo, $49.99/yr or $99.99 once for lifetime access; both subscriptions start with a 7-day free trial. It's an app for iPhone, iPad and Mac; the App Store lists Mac as requiring macOS 14.0 or later and a Mac with Apple M1 chip or later. No account is needed and data stays on your device. TutorTally never handles payments: invoices include a "How to pay" block so families pay you directly, and we found no parent portal. TutorTally · App Store listing {{aff:tutortally|Visit TutorTally}}

Duet: low-cost, not free, and possibly inactive

Duet has no free plan. Its pricing page lists a 30-day free trial, then $9/mo or $99/yr flat, with families paying a 1% fee on digital payments. But the promotions on that page expired in 2024 and the footer still says ©2024, so we couldn't confirm Duet is still actively developed. Check before you move your studio to it.

What 10 students cost

Using published prices only: Trio Free and Nova Music Free are $0. TutorTally is $9.99/mo, $49.99/yr or $99.99 once (the free tier covers 2 students). Duet is $9/mo or $99/yr. mySymphony Solo is $0.25 per booked lesson, capped at $20/mo (see mySymphony). At 11 or more students, Trio Pro ($5/mo) and Nova Music Pro ($10/mo) are the cheapest subscriptions on this page.

What we couldn't confirm

Not published on vendor pages: Trio and Nova Music card processing rates and contract terms; Nova Music's parent portal and autopay details; online booking for Trio, Nova Music and TutorTally; and whether Duet is still maintained. We don't publish ratings.

faq: Is there free music lesson software?
Yes. Trio and Nova Music both have $0 plans for up to 10 students, and TutorTally is free for your first 2 students with every feature included (checked Nov 2, 2026).
Trio Pro is $5/mo or $50/yr and removes the 10-student limit. Additional team seats are $5/mo or $50/yr each, and Max is $20/mo or $200/yr.
Can I take card payments on a free plan?

Not on the free plans we checked. Trio Free takes cash and check only (online payments are on Pro). TutorTally never processes payments on any plan. Nova Music's free plan doesn't list billing; advanced billing is on Pro ($10/mo).
TutorTally offers lifetime access for $99.99 once, or $9.99/mo or $49.99/yr. It runs on iPhone, iPad and Mac (Apple M1 or later).
No. Duet lists a 30-day free trial, then $9/mo or $99/yr. Its pricing page promotions date from 2024, so check that it's still active.
